summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting stockholder approval and subsequent cashless exercise of pre-funded warrants to issue 12,131,122 shares of common stock. Following the exercise, ATM sales, and other issuances, shares outstanding totaled 13,693,866. Market capitalization was about $23.0 million, while stockholders' equity was approximately $103 million, curing Nasdaq listing deficiencies. No acquisition, tender, or strategic event is present; the filing solely updates capitalization status.
